page.overview:
Who is Barley Barrel and Pickle Barrel?

Cutecumber (sister) Dill and Sweet (parents)

Barley Barrel and G4 Pickle Barrel are Pegasus pony foals and supporting characters in the hour-long special My Little Pony: Rainbow Roadtrip. They are fraternal twins, residents of Hope Hollow, and president and assistant president respectively of Rainbow Dash's fan club in Hope Hollow.

G5 Pickle Barrel is a male Earth pony/seapony original character who appears in the IDW comics' IDW Endless Summer—My Little Pony, , and My Little Pony: Set Your Sail Issue #4.__TOC__

In early March 2023, G5 Pickle Barrel was conceptualized by Riley Farmer and drawn by Natalie Haines.
